reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with Jose and his crew! They stuccoed our house and installed a metal roof awning over a window. Communication throughout the project was excellent—they were responsive, respectful, and professional. The quality of their work was top-notch, and we’re thrilled with the results. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Megan Meyer

reviews.text: We had our roof replaced in October of 2023 with White Rock Roofing. Jose, our rep, was awesome in going through the entire process with us and the Insurance company. We were completely happy with all aspects of the transaction. So much that we also had them rebuild our leaky back patio and raise the ceiling on our attached sunroom. Their team was professional and did amazing work! It’s crazy how little changes like raising the ceiling, new paint, adding in a few more can lights can improve the quality of your everyday life so much. We highly recommend White Rock Roofing for anyone needing their roof replaced or any other construction/renovations needs.
reviews.author: cxc02a

reviews.text: I rarely write reviews, but I recently hired Jose Reyes of White Rock Roofing to inspect and repair roof leaks and CREATE a custom chimney cap. The entire process was smooth and stress-free. Jose and his team were punctual and knowledgeable and delivered outstanding work. The roof repairs are flawless, and the custom chimney cap looks amazing and is perfect. Their pricing was below other estimates while offering greater quality of service and craftsmanship. It's refreshing to support a local business owner like Jose, who genuinely cares about his customers. I highly recommend White Rock Roofing for any roofing or chimney needs.
reviews.author: erich kirk

reviews.text: I initially reached out to Jose for a simple gutter cleaning, based on a recommendation from a friend.  Jose responded promptly and came out to assess our gutters with professionalism and care.  During the inspection, he noticed some damage we hadn’t been aware of and suggested a small adjustment to prevent future water buildup.  Within a day, Jose and his team returned to complete the repairs and clean the gutters thoroughly, all at a very reasonable price.  At no point did I feel pressured into unnecessary work or upselling.  The entire experience was smooth, honest, and efficient.  I highly recommend White Rock Roofing to anyone looking for reliable and trustworthy service!
reviews.author: Amy Mai

reviews.text: Jose at White Rock Roofing did a great job! We had some needed roof repair he was able to take care of on a steep part of our two story home that was a bit difficult to access. Jose was able to take pictures with a drone to confirm the damage, then access it to do all the necessary repairs. He even called me a couple weeks later to follow up and make sure I was still satisfied with the work! He did a great job, and I was impressed. Not to mention, he charged a very reasonable rate. I will call White Rock Roofing in the future if anything else comes up.
reviews.author: Sara Routh

reviews.text: When I contacted White Rock and Jose immediately responded the same day and came out the next to give me an estimate. He walked me through the process and answered all my questions as this was the first time I’d gone through this process. I had a few other roofers to come by, but I felt really good with Jose and what they were going to provide me. So I decided to choose them. I’m so glad I did! They are honest and the work provided was/is beautiful. I had a lot of water damage under my existing roofing, which explained the links I was getting when it rained hard. They repaired all of that with new attic vents, etc. They arrived early in the morning and did an excellent job on my roof. I would highly recommend White Rock for any of your roofing needs. I’m a happy customer!
reviews.author: Lisa Sims

reviews.text: Julio and Jose both guarantee outstanding work! I had a leak that was staining the ceiling of my bedroom after a big rain. Julio came out the next day and had the issue fixed within 24 hours of contacting them! The job was done extremely well and at a great price. Highly Recommend!!
reviews.author: Michael Perish

reviews.text: I worked with Jose to repair the roof of one my properties. He was gracious enough to work with the insurance adjuster when he came out to inspect the roof. He helped me navigate through all the repair and claim process with the insurance company. I would recommend White Rock Roofing to anyone who wants quality and professional work done. Thank you for all the help Jose!
reviews.author: Benny Oyoo

reviews.text: Fantastic job, new roof, gutters, Lot of carpentry was needed and new metal. I am fussy, particular, and Jose and his team did a high quality job.  Bit the key reason to choose Jose and WRR is that he’s an expert on claims and works extremely well with my insurance company.  Jose got us $20k more than we expected.
reviews.author: Robert Bulger

reviews.text: Highly recommend White Rock Roofing. They did a fantastic job removing the old roof and installing the new one. They also installed three skylights, which look excellent and prepared for our Texas weather. Jose treated the project like his own, which made it easy to decide materials and colors, and his prices were also very competitive. I would absolutely recommend White Rock Roofing for your roofing or general contracting needs. Thanks Jose!!
reviews.author: W H

reviews.text: They replaced my dad's roof in February and he is very pleased with the outcome. Julio and Jose were very responsive and always ready to follow up with any questions or concerns my dad had. They were able to really fight on his behalf with his insurance claim, and he was able to get more coverage than previously awarded. The new roof was installed in one day and the crew did an excellent job! The roof looks amazing and more importantly, we have no more roof leaks!! The crew also did a good job of cleaning up afterwards.  Overall, we are very very happy with White Rock Roofing and can not recommend them enough! 😀
reviews.author: Michele Back

reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful company to work with! Jose Reyes was amazing with response time, wisdom, and guidance while navigating a very difficult insurance claim. After months of battling with Allstate, I was able to negotiate a whole roof replacement, all with the help of Jose. Would recommend White Rock Roofing for anyone who needs roof work.
reviews.author: Nathan Yockey

reviews.text: We had a great experience with White Rock Roofing. Our roof was hail damaged and they worked with us from the beginning of the claim through installation. Jorge and Jose were our main points of contact and they were extremely responsive, thoughtful, and answered any question we had. They installed extra ventilation that was an improvement over our original roof.  Highly recommend their work to any homeowner looking to replace the roof on your home.
reviews.author: Amanda F

reviews.text: Jose provided a bid pretty quickly.  Bid seemed very reasonable.  I hesitated a bit but ultimately decided to move forward with the repair.  Jose and his team were professional and the repair work was completed within a couple days of my approval.  Work was very well done.  Would use them again.
reviews.author: Kenny

reviews.text: Not only did White Rock Roofing did an excellent job using quality products for my roof  but also did a complete siding job! I explained in detail what I wanted out of the siding job and they delivered! They are very responsive and prompt with their communication and work. I would definitely recommend and hire them again!
reviews.author: Rosa Guzman

reviews.text: I recently had my roof replaced by White Rock Roofing and I am happy with the results. Julio and Jose answering all my questions and explaining the process in detail. The crew did a very good job.
reviews.author: Gabriela

reviews.text: I hired White Rock Roofing to do a detailed inspection on a house I just purchased. Jose looked in every corner of the attic, checked the skylights and the roof. They confirmed what I suspected, leaks in several areas from previous (poorly done) roof repairs. They replaced several skylights, flashing, and performed other repairs. They took multiple before and after photos of each repair, which we really appreciated because it helped us fully understand what the issues were. Jose is very thorough. He also noticed a few issues with the bricks and masonry on the roof (huge 2” gaps where the grout was missing). His crews repaired that as well and it looks flawless. Jose even checked in with us after a storm to be sure everything was well with the repairs. I’d definitely call White Rock Roofing again in the future. Also, they are professional and show up when they say they are. They left the job site clean at the end of each day. They are fair with their pricing and take pride in their work.
reviews.author: Jess S

reviews.text: Highly recommend White Rock Roofing. José and Julio have been excellent to work with. They are professional, thorough and honest. New roof and ventilation look awesome!
reviews.author: Mary Wenner

reviews.text: Jose from White Rock Roofing was great. On-time for the scheduled appointment and provided great roof inspection, and gave reasonable quote for roof maintenance and performed the job on same day. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.text: Jose at White Rock Roofing is a rockstar! He helped us navigate the insurance process from start to finish and we got a great outcome. It was a smooth and professional process all the way through. He was extremely helpful with communication and followup during all stages from quoting, installaltion, and insurance relations. I can't recommend him highly enough.
reviews.author: Zac Lytle

reviews.text: The White Rock team was super helpful in finding the cause of my major roof leak which two other companies did not do. They were able to come out and fix my roof the very next day which was amazing since it was supposed to rain the next week. They did not sell me anything I didn’t need and was a very fair price, I can’t thank them enough for coming and fixing my roof exceptionally quickly.
reviews.author: Melanie Shempert

reviews.text: GREAT work! on time, very professional and respectful to homeowner’s property( I have first-hand experience where the damage caused by workers are worth more than the job itself, so I was super glad to see that Jose and his crew paid attention when moving equipments in and out of my place, not to damage/ dirty my floor/walls/furnitures, etc). And in addition to their efficiency and diligence, I also really like their attitude - my job is a small but skillful job and I have been searching high and low to find a good company to do the job and most of the companies turned my request down when they heard the job description. This is the roof company I’ll stick with. As a homeowner, the stress is almost never about getting the house projects done, but with finding a good company/crew to do it. Also, the job as shown in the pic, is a roof access hatch installation.
reviews.author: Qiuting Hu

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Julio and White Rock Roofing! Julio took care of everything and went back and forth several times with my insurance company who was being difficult. He made sure I got everything possible covered. Jose and his install team were very professional and did an amazing job installing the roof. They even fixed a few things they didn’t necessarily have to! I would highly recommend White Rock Roofing to anyone!
reviews.author: Leslie Loposer

reviews.text: We are so happy with our experience with White Rock Roofing! They are such a great team. We needed a new roof, siding, and gutters. They gave us a great price and helped so much with our insurance claim. They advocated on our behalf to get the coverage we needed and got the work done super quickly. Would definitely do business with them again.
reviews.author: Rachel and Walter

reviews.text: These guys are great. Very easy to work with and knowledgeable about how to work with the insurance company throughout the claims process. They knocked out the entire roof in a day, added a few touches to improve on how it was done originally, and cleaned up perfectly well after they were finished. We even had a couple boards that needed replaced and they didn’t skip a beat getting them fixed. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Juan Alfredo

reviews.text:
I recently hired White Rock Roofing after experiencing leaks in my bathroom roof. From the first phone call, their professionalism stood out. Jose Reyes arrived promptly for the inspection and quickly identified several installation errors from my previous roofing job.

Mike took the time to show me exactly what was wrong - improper nail patterns, missing flashing and ice/water membranes, missing drip edge in several areas, and incorrectly installed shingles near the valleys. He documented everything with photos and explained how each issue contributed to my leaking problems.

What impressed me most was their honesty. Mike provided a detailed estimate to fix only what was necessary rather than pushing for a full replacement. His team arrived when promised, worked efficiently, and cleaned up thoroughly after completing the repairs.

I wish I could have hired them for the original job, but I'm grateful they were able to correct the previous company's mistakes without a complete tear-off.

If you need roofing work done right the first time (or fixed from someone else's mistakes), I can't recommend White Rock Roofing highly enough. True professionals who stand behind their work!
reviews.author: Stephen Mathew

reviews.text: Jose absolutely saved the day! He was so quick to respond when I found a leak. Turns out it was a rotting window frame. He was able to have it replaced before the next storm. The same day we had a huge tree limb fall in our yard. His team was able to get that removed quickly too!
reviews.author: Sarah Beckham

reviews.text: Julio and his team were great to work with start to finish. They helped get a tarp on a hole in my roof quickly and were extremely available and responsive to coordinate with me and my insurance. They knocked out the full roof in just a day and cut zero corners. The project manager, Juan, found some previous issues above a bathroom and helped get it repaired and was such a pleasure to work with. I can’t say enough about everyone at White Rock Roofing.
reviews.author: Daniel Winter
